title: Binance hit by massive cyber heist

slides.headline: Binance hit by massive cyber heist
slides.subtitle: $6.3 billion in cryptocurrency stolen
slides.say: This is a serious security breach.

slides.explanation: Major platforms have already managed to freeze $3 billion of the stolen funds. That is roughly half of the total amount taken in the attack.

slides.headline: Evidence points toward North Korean hackers
slides.explanation: Blockchain analysts have linked the attack to North Korea. This suggests the heist may be a state-sponsored effort to generate revenue.
slides.say: The trail leads to state actors.

slides.explanation: Eight independent news outlets have verified the details of this hack. While estimates on the total amount vary, the core facts remain consistent.

slides.subtitle: Get the full story on Headlinne.

caption:
Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has been targeted in a record-breaking cyber heist.

Initial reports indicate that $6.3 billion worth of digital assets were taken during the attack.

In a rare win for security, major platforms acted quickly to freeze $3 billion of the stolen funds by Thursday night. Blockchain intelligence firms are now tracing the activity back to North Korea, raising questions about state-sponsored cyber warfare.

story.title: Biggest hack in history: Cryptocurrency giant Binance loses $6.3 billion
story.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange giant Binance has been targeted by a record-breaking $6.3 billion cyber heist, with blockchain intelligence firms linking the attack to North Korea. By Thursday night in the US, a coordinated effort by major crypto platforms successfully froze roughly $3 billion of the stolen assets during a high-stakes race to track and secure the digital funds.
